first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The only running person in this clip, with short dark hair, a dark short-sleeved top, and white shorts. The back of the head, back, and shorts are seen from a low position behind, with the legs and feet mostly outside the frame.

entities.name: passageway surface
entities.identification: The central passageway surface along which Person A travels, paved with light-gray panels featuring fine grooves, seams, and dot-like holes, and curving continuously into the depth of the image.

entities.name: bulkhead
entities.identification: The light gray-white enclosing bulkheads on both sides of the passageway, featuring panel seams, dark rectangular openings, and built-in facilities.

entities.name: curved structure
entities.identification: The set of large, light-colored arc-shaped components on the upper left and right of the image, with clearly visible multilayered contours along their inner and outer edges.

entities.name: light strip
entities.identification: The continuous blue-white luminous strips arranged along the outer edges of the curved structures and the adjacent bulkheads; the set does not include the small buttons on the control panels.

entities.name: control panel
entities.identification: The set of dark rectangular panels on the bulkheads, beside the desks, and along the edges of recesses, with groups of bright buttons, indicator areas, or screens visible on the panels.

entities.name: wall niche
entities.identification: The set of bright recessed spaces in the side walls, with white inner walls, rectangular lights, and partial countertops; they need not be inferred to be hatch doors that are opening or closing.

entities.name: bulkhead recess
entities.identification: The set of tall, rounded-rectangular recesses on both sides of the center of this clip, with dark inner edges surrounding elongated light blue-gray or light-gray inner surfaces; some narrow at the top and have the outline of a small opening, with small control panels nearby.
